title: SG-2 Author inventory item icon sources and register them
summary: Add palette-indexed inventory icon grids, generate them to PNG and register them in the manifest
description: Context: the last check found SG-2 unmet only because no inventory item icons exist. The art sources (game/frontend/src/art) hold the room, boy, secret door and dust grids, but nothing for items, and the manifest (game/public/assets/worlds/the-boys-room/manifest.json) has no item entries. Desired behavior: palette-indexed icon grids for at least six items (enough for the 3x2 inventory grid) are authored, generated to PNG by the existing art:generate script, registered at their declared size, and covered by the existing manifest palette and size test. Why: the SG-2 'Done when' lists inventory item icons explicitly.
acceptance_criteria: Given the art sources, When generateAssets runs, Then at least six ids with the prefix item/ are produced as single-frame PNGs.
Given the committed manifest, When compared to generated entries, Then every item/ entry matches exactly and each PNG size equals its declared dimensions.
Given every item icon frame, When converted through the palette, Then every pixel is a palette colour and no svg is referenced.

in_scope: Generating the PNGs and manifest entries with art:generate
Extending the manifest palette and size test to the icons
out_of_scope: Rendering icons in the Story Panel inventory grid
New rooms, new story content, backend changes, audio, deployment, repository clean-up
Rebuilding the room, boy or interface art that already exists
preserve: Existing ART_SOURCES entries and their committed manifest entries
Phaser 3.90.x pin and the existing guard tests
Shared palette of at most 48 colours

technical_constraints: All art is raster pixel art generated in the repo from source data by the deterministic art:generate script; no downloaded art or image services.
One shared palette of at most 48 colours, defined once in game/frontend/src/lib/palette.ts.
Tests are unit tests with all dependencies mocked.
Phaser stays on 3.90.x; React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind, Radix and Zustand stay.
definition_of_done: All requirements below are met and their Verify units pass.
non_functional: Generation is deterministic: identical input gives identical bytes.
